item: FDA comment period closes on the CDRH discussion paper on generative-AI-enabled medical devices (FDA-2026-N-7874)
Comments close on FDA's Nonclinical Testing Terminology direct final rule; one significant adverse comment withdraws it, otherwise effective 2027-02-04
Amylyx plans an NDA submission for avexitide (post-bariatric hypoglycemia)
Senate confirmation vote on Heidi Overton's nomination as FDA Commissioner
Comments close on CDRH FY 2027 guidance priorities (docket FDA-2012-N-1021), incl. final AI-enabled device lifecycle and PCCP guidance
Transparency in Coverage (CMS-9882-F) self-service tool changes apply, incl. cost-sharing by phone, for plan years on or after this date
Comments close on CMS-4214-P (CAA 2026 sections 6219/6220/6224: MA provider directory accuracy, Part D PBM accountability)
CMS-9873-P (proposed) ACA exchange pre-open-enrollment eligibility verification period would begin, if finalized as proposed
Inovio's draft confirmatory-trial protocol for Voceryq (RRP) due to FDA; final protocol expected mid-2027
PFS requirement that Medicare pays for RPM/RTM only when furnished by the practice's own clinical staff takes effect (delayed two years in CY 2027 PFS final rule)
Stakeholder feedback due to Sen. Cassidy (HELP) on PATIENT AI Act discussion draft (FDA software review, CMS coverage of AI services)
HIPAA Privacy Rule final rule (coordinated care, individual access; OCR, finalized 2026-11-16) takes effect
Compliance date for HIPAA Privacy Rule final rule: 15-day access deadline, app access, verification limits; BAAs by 2028-01-18
